visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An adult Asian male stands in a brightly lit indoor living room, wearing a white short-sleeved t-shirt and light blue athletic shorts. He has a light blue hooded towel perched on his head and is carrying a baby on his left hip. The baby is dressed in a light purple shirt and a patterned bib. In the background, a white air purifier is visible alongside a decorative red floral wall hanging and a wooden cabinet. (2) The man turns away from the camera and walks down a narrow hallway towards a doorway. He maintains a firm grip on the baby as they move. A pull-up bar is visible mounted near the top of the hallway walls. The floor is light-colored wood, and the environment appears tidy and domestic. (3) The scene cuts to a baby sitting inside a large, bright yellow plastic bathtub located within a bathroom with white square-tiled walls. The shirtless baby is energetically splashing water with both hands, creating significant droplets that spray against the tub and the surrounding floor. The lighting is direct and bright, highlighting the water's motion. (4) A graphic intertitle appears with a red background decorated with stylized pineapple motifs. Large black text in a playful font reads 'A FEW MOMENTS LATER' in the center of the frame. This animation serves as a temporal transition between the bathing process and its conclusion. (5) The father reappears at the bathroom door, looking completely drenched from head to toe. His white t-shirt is soaked through and clings to his body, becoming nearly translucent. He holds the baby, who is now wrapped in a light blue towel. The father uses his right hand to wipe excess water from his forehead and face while facing the camera. (6) A medium close-up shot shows the father and baby in the hallway. The father continues to wipe water away and gestures with his hands while looking at the camera with a mix of amusement and resignation. The baby looks calmly toward the lens. Water is visibly dripping from the father's hair and clothing onto the floor.
